name: M-161-1 (Hubble)
blurb: M-161-1, an isolated ultra-diffuse galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: m1611-hubble
story: A faint, sprawling galaxy with few stars spread thin across a wide glow, living far from crowded neighborhoods. It has stopped forming stars and holds little gas, a puzzle for a galaxy so isolated.

claims.text: M-161-1 is a low surface brightness galaxy targeted by Hubble program 14846 on ultra-diffuse galaxies
M-161-1 is a relatively isolated ultra-diffuse galaxy
Its properties are puzzling given its isolation
